## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A short single-fascicle Buddha-biography sūtra recounting the previous lives of Śākyamuni in compressed narrative. The title's 異出 ("variant version") signals that this is an alternative Buddha-biography presentation, complementing the translations of [T184](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6b/KR6b0040), [T185](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6b/KR6b0041), and [T186](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6b/KR6b0042). Translated by [聶道真](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E8%81%B6%E9%81%93%E7%9C%9F) Niè Dàozhēn in the Western Jìn. Signature: 「西晉居士聶道真譯」.

**Abstract**

T188 is one of [聶道真](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E8%81%B6%E9%81%93%E7%9C%9F) Niè Dàozhēn's documented Western-Jìn translations, dated to his post-[Dharmarakṣa](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E7%AB%BA%E6%B3%95%E8%AD%B7) active period in the late third / early fourth century. The Indic source is unidentified; the *yìchū* ("variant version") title-element suggests the work was issued explicitly as an alternative recension of Buddha-biography material already available in earlier Chinese translation. The brief single-fascicle format places T188 in the *avadāna*-summary category of Buddha-biography rather than the full-length *Lalitavistara*-class genre.
